cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

mechanism: A uses its pupil learned model-before-action discipline to force a choice between shrinking people and growing room, then demands the consequence of B chosen model.
confusable: Not surveying possibilities indefinitely: A makes one mutually incompatible account govern the practical move.
comparison: Body/room scale choice versus absent-gravity service choice.
seedUse: D154 sofa/size/help/brother/tweezers; S05 choosing model before solution.
